root_cause.text: Memory allocated for beacon templates in `ath11k_mac_setup_bcn_tmpl_ema()` and `ath11k_mac_setup_bcn_tmpl_mbssid()` is not freed on error paths when parameter setup or validation fails, causing memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and patch commit message explicitly state that the functions "allocate memory for beacon templates but fail to free it when parameter setup returns an error." The patch diff shows the addition of `goto free` labels and moving `ieee80211_beacon_free_ema_list(beacons)` and `kfree_skb(bcn)` to common exit points, ensuring deallocation on all paths including error returns.
